name: RealFi USDrf
oneLiner: USDrf is RealFi's Cardano dollar token backed by off-chain credit, with a stated Treasury liquidity buffer and institution-only direct redemption.
collateral: U.S. Treasury bills and tokenized government money market funds, emerging-market floating-rate corporate bonds, investment-grade CLO ETFs, private credit funds and direct private loans. Published allocation ranges describe strategy, not verified holdings, and no reserve attestation has been published.
pegMechanism: Whitelisted institutions mint and redeem at $1 less fees through a human-approved FIFO queue whose daily and monthly limits are unpublished; timing is not guaranteed and RealFi can suspend redemptions. Holders without an institutional account have no direct claim and exit on Cardano DEXes. A first-loss reserve of undisclosed size and the junior sUSDrf tranche absorb losses before USDrf.

milestones.title: RealFi introduces USDr and its staked sUSDr
milestones.description: RealFi's introductory post presents USDr as the protocol's stablecoin and sUSDr as its staked layer. The Cardano asset still carries the on-chain name USDr, while RealFi now brands it USDrf.

milestones.title: RealFi announces testnet phase 1 opening July 6
